### <span class="method-badge" data-method="PUT">PUT</span> `/cluster/multipath/overrides`

```ts
proxmox.cluster.multipath.overrides.$put()
```

Set the verbatim multipath.conf sections for hardware-specific settings: 'devices', 'overrides', 'defaults', 'blacklist' and 'blacklist_exceptions' blocks, for example a 'devices' section with 'device' subsections.

Returns nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `digest` | string |  | Prevent changes if current configuration file has a different digest. This can be used to prevent concurrent modifications. — ≤ 64 chars |
| `overrides` | string |  | Verbatim override sections. Omit to clear them. — ≤ 131072 chars |

### <span class="method-badge" data-method="POST">POST</span> `/cluster/multipath/wwid`

```ts
proxmox.cluster.multipath.wwid.$post()
```

Add an explicit multipath entry for a LUN, with an optional alias, node restriction, and per-LUN settings. For a LUN of an iSCSI storage with multipath enabled, an entry is only needed to set an alias or per-LUN settings. The entry keeps the LUN managed even if the storage's 'managed-multipath' option is disabled.

Returns nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `alias` | string |  | The name of the multipath map. — ≤ 64 chars |
| `digest` | string |  | Prevent changes if current configuration file has a different digest. This can be used to prevent concurrent modifications. — ≤ 64 chars |
| `no-path-retry` | string |  | The action or number of retries when all paths are down. |
| `nodes` | string |  | The nodes that should assemble the map, or all nodes when unset. — format `pve-node-list` |
| `paths-expected` | number |  | The number of paths each node should have to the LUN. A node with fewer paths reports the LUN as degraded. — min 1 |
| `wwid` | string | yes | The WWID of the LUN to manage via multipath. — ≤ 128 chars |
